4.5.2: If you use GPS and never set gps_ublox_flight_model, 4.5.2 used AIRBORNE_1G. The converted config gets AIRBORNE_4G, as updating to 4.5.3 or later would (PR #14334). To keep 1G, add: set gps_ublox_flight_model = AIRBORNE_1G
